Gameplay is fun, but there's not too much content in the game currently. I got to endgame in basically a week of playing, and all I have now is to wait for weekly resets and wait for crafts to finish. Gunplay is pretty nice, Ultimates and Transcendents feel pretty unique although Transcendants feel a little weak rn. Wish the game wasn't so gooner bc its pretty fun. I would consider buying cosmetics if some of them weren't so overly-sexualized. I don't mind fanservice, but some of the outfits feel like they're comically oversexualized (e.x. dia's default outfit). They are also a little pricey for what they are. Most of the descendants I tried were pretty fun. I like that they have augments that allow you to have different playstyles with them. I hope they take the time to buff some of the weaker characters tho, Raven feels like she blows all other descendants out of the water power-wise, while a good third of the cast has a lot of trouble clearing endgame activities. I also love the library system, you can see where to obtain anything in the game without having to look on a wiki. I wish more games were like that tbh, Wish the game was also a little better optimized. I have a pretty decent PC but even on low settings I have stutters and freezes. Also, where's my male character jiggle physics? Why cant Lepic have ass and bulge physics? You are cowards Nexon.

Game def has potential tho, if it's still around years from now I could rival Warframe in terms of content. But for now, I'll probably play this game on the side when an update comes out or while I'm waiting for Warframe updates lol.

Too much to do that is all the same, not anything to do that is fresh, and none of it is clear. Juggling menus and files just to fight chumps or bullet-sponges; learning the different names for the 15 SAME kinds of missions, having to learn an encyclopedia, and they expect you to fork over the cash. Well they don't respect you or your time even if you give them money, so skip it.
